purpose: Material-level detection provenance and reproducibility registry. Keep one entry per material whenever a material uses staged prompts, range-specific thresholds, or post-detection repair modules.

passenger_wiper_1113.label: 副雨刮器

stages.name: table_view_single
stages.reason: Open-table single/paired wipers segment cleanly with the original wiper prompts; no contact/bin-specific filtering is needed.
prompts: black automotive windshield wiper blade
passenger side windshield wiper blade
black rubber windshield wiper blade assembly
curved black car wiper blade
front windshield wiper blade
stages.command_template: python detect_material_bgr.py --input-dir data/副雨刮器总成_1113/bgr --output-dir out/passenger_wiper_1100 --label 副雨刮器 --min-score 0.35 --min-area-frac 0.0003 --max-area-frac 0.08 --max-bbox-fill-frac 0.55 --iou-dedup 0.4 --score-threshold-detection 0.2 --new-det-thresh 0.3 --include-prefix <table prefix> --text-prompt ...

stages.name: table_view_manual_pair_repair
stages.reason: Frame 20260521_151819__000148 contains two table-view wipers. The generic table prompts selected only the foreground angled blade, so this repair uses rear-horizontal/table prompts and caps the output at two high-score blade instances.
prompts: long black horizontal windshield wiper blade at the back of the green table
rear horizontal black windshield wiper blade only
black straight wiper blade with rectangular center connector on table
black rubber blade lying horizontally near the wall
two black windshield wiper blades on green table
single black windshield wiper blade on green table only

validation_examples.expected: two table-view wiper detections; rear horizontal blade recovered and table noise excluded

rebuild_notes: Do not use --clean for exploratory reruns unless the entire material will be rebuilt afterward.
For targeted fixes, use --include-prefix with --min-stem/--max-stem so stable single/table detections are not overwritten.

Current special CLI support added for reproducibility: detect_material_bgr.py accepts --max-instances, --min-relative-score, --min-stem, --max-stem, and --image-list; run_material_segmentation.py forwards these profile fields.
Scene-specific parameters are stored as separate JSON files under configs/materials/副雨刮器; use --label 副雨刮器 for the pure material label.
